widgets.widgetName: S S N, I T I N, F E I N, C A S O S file number, or C A corporation no (12 digits)
Name(s) as shown on tax return
Line 1. Description of property
Line 10. Adjusted basis. Subtract line 9 from line 8
Line 11. Commissions and other expenses of sale
Line 12. Income recapture from Schedule D-1, Part III and Part IV. See instructions
Line 13. Add line 10, line 11, and line 12
Line 14. Subtract line 13 from line 5. If zero or less, stop here. Do not complete the rest of this form
Line 15. If the above property was your main home, using California amounts, enter your excluded gain. Otherwise, enter 0
Line 16. Gross profit. Subtract line 15 from line 14
Line 17. Subtract line 13 from line 6. If zero or less, enter 0
Line 18. Contract price. Add line 7 and line 17
Line 19. Gross profit percentage (expressed as a decimal amount, see instructions). Divide line 16 by line 18. For years after the sale, see instructions
Line 20. For year of sale only - Enter amount from line 17 above. Otherwise, enter 0
Line 21. Payments received during the year (do not include stated or unstated interest)
Line 22. Add line 20 and line 21
Line 2a. Date acquired (mm/dd/yyyy)
Line 2b. Date sold (mm/dd/yyyy)

Line 3. Was the property sold to a related party after December 31, 1980? If "Yes," complete Part III for the year of sale and 2 years after the year of the sale unless you received the final payment during the tax year
Line 4. Can the total selling price be determined by the close of the tax year in which such sale or other disposition occurs?
Part I, Line 5. Selling price including mortgages and other debts (do not include stated or unstated interest)
Line 6. Mortgages and other debts the buyer assumed or took the property subject to, but not new mortgages the buyer got from a bank or other source
Line 7. Subtract line 6 from line 5
Line 8. Cost or other basis of property sold
Line 9. Depreciation allowed or allowable. Use California amounts
Line 23. Payments received in prior years (do not include stated or unstated interest)
Line 24. Installment sale income. Multiply line 22 by line 19. This amount cannot be zero or less. See instructions
Line 25. Enter the part of line 24 that is ordinary income under recapture rules. See instructions
Line 26. Subtract line 25 from line 24. Enter the result here and on Schedule D (540, 540NR, 541, 565, 568, or 100S) or Schedule D-1
Part III, Line 27. Name, address, and taxpayer identification number of related party
Line 28. Did the related party, during this taxable year, resell or dispose of the property ("second disposition")?
Line 29. If you checked "Yes," on line 28, complete line 30 through line 37 below unless one of the following conditions is met. Check only the box that applies
widgets.text: (a) The second disposition was more than two years after the first disposition (other than dispositions of marketable securities).

widgets.widgetName: If this box is checked, enter the date of the disposition (mm/dd/yyyy)
Line 30. Selling price of property sold by related party
Line 31. Enter contract price from line 18 for year of first sale
Line 32. Enter the smaller of line 30 or line 31
Line 33. Total payments received by the end of your 2025 taxable year. Add line 22 and line 23
Line 34. Subtract line 33 from line 32. If zero or less, enter 0
Line 35. Multiply line 34 by the gross profit percentage on line 19 for year of first sale
Line 36. Enter the part of line 35 that is ordinary income under recapture rules. See instructions
Line 37. Subtract line 36 from line 35. Enter the result here and on Schedule D (540, 540NR, 541, 565, 568, or 100S) or Schedule D-1
